parameters.help_zh: EAIS实例名称，支持使用通配符*进行模糊搜索
parameters.name: instance_name

parameters.help_en:
The status of the EAIS instance. The status varies based on how the instance was created:

If you call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2618548.html to create the EAIS instance:

Pending: The instance is being prepared.

Creating: The instance is being created.

Bindable: The instance can be attached.

Bound: The instance is attached.

InUse: The instance is in use.

If you call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2618555.html to create the EAIS instance:

Starting: The instance is being created.

Available: The instance can be attached.

Attaching: The instance is being attached.

InUse: The instance is attached.

Detaching: The instance is being detached
parameters.help_zh:
EAIS实例状态。具体状态与创建EAIS实例的方式有关，说明如下：
调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2618548.html创建EAIS实例：
Pending：准备中
Creating：创建中
Bindable：可绑定
Bound：已绑定
InUse：使用中
调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2618555.html创建EAIS实例：
Starting：创建中
Available：可绑定
Attaching：绑定中
InUse：已绑定
Detaching：解绑中
parameters.name: status

The key of a tag. You can specify up to 20 tags. If you filter resources by a single tag, up to 1,000 resources can be returned. If you filter resources by multiple tags, up to 1,000 resources that have all the specified tags can be returned.

If you filter resources by a single tag, the number of resources returned for that tag is limited to 1,000. If you filter resources by multiple tags, the number of resources that match all specified tags is limited to 1,000
